q: Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.
Find and kill "the Collector" then return to Marshal Dughan with The Collector's Ring.
Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
Bring Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie's Heads to Genavie Callow in Undercity.
Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.
Go to the Silver Stream Mine and collect 4 loads of Miners' Gear.
One of the oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb has Sida's bag, retrieve it and bring it back to her in Menethil Harbor.

Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.
Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!

Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrat
Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.
Speak to Thrall in Orgrimmar and tell him what you've learned.
Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.
Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

Steal the Defias Tower Key, break into the Defias Tower and uncover the contents of the Duskwood Chest. Take whatever information you find back to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. Read Kearnen's Journal to gain insight about the tower.
Steal Silixiz's Tower Key from Foreman Silixiz, then kill two Mutated Venture Co. Drones, two Venture Co. Patrollers, and two Venture Co. Lookouts.

Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Sabatons if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sabatons, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Cured Rugged Hides, 2 Nexus Crystals and 25 gold pieces.

Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Plagueheart Robe if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Robe, 25 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals.
